name: Light Fades Twice Lizalfos + Chilfos + Darknut PRIVATE TEST

description: 0.13.15 DARKNUT MINIBOSS FIX06 (DKN01): the normal Darknut of Enemy Spawner only (B_TN 0x000001FF): phase 1 with 600 HP, posture 200 and progressive armour, phases 2/3 with 480 resistance and posture 160/180; an authentic parry by the Darknut opens a sequence it owns (60 % a combo, 40 % a counter that continues into a combo 80 % of the time) that Link's ordinary attacks, blocks and parries cannot interrupt (breaks, defeat and the other legitimate exceptions still win); F2-C2/F2-C4 five intervals retimed; phase-1 Mortal Draw / Helm Splitter (100 HP); the Helm Splitter stagger sways instead of freezing; one native jump after a resurrection / getup; the sword darkens with the body in the definitive death; LGC01, DKR01 resurrection and executions unchanged; every other enemy unchanged.
